digest.component_or_area: CLI guide system and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: Clients using rebar CLI without a rebar checkout encounter broken internal cross-references in packaged guides due to consumer-relative paths like `review-policy.md`, `../CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `docs/commit-ticket-trailer.md`.
The required `rebar-ticket` commit-trailer format has no CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in `rebar verify-commit-ticket --help` with no cross-linking from guides or help prose.

Packaged author guides must repoint all dangling references to use either `rebar explain <topic>` for sibling guides or `https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/…` URLs for repo-only docs to resolve offline.

A comprehensive link-resolution guard test must prevent regression by asserting no packaged guide markdown link target is consumer-relative and every `rebar explain` citation names a registered guide/criterion.
